description: Oxygen through a 400 um aerobic biofilm at 37 C, held at a fixed biomass and solved to steady state. Most of the film sits beyond the penetration depth and does not grow, although every cell in it is identical.
assumptions: Flat biofilm of uniform density; no structure, channels or roughness.
Biomass is fixed: this is the profile a given biofilm supports, not its development over time.
Oxygen is the only limiting substrate; all other nutrients are in excess.
The bulk liquid holds the surface concentration constant, and the base is impermeable.
Effective diffusivity is 0.43 of the value in water, the mean Stewart (1998) reports for small nonpolar solutes.
Parameters are illustrative (confidence C in docs/parameters.md) and do not describe a particular strain.
